title: Packet retention-failure memory: record identity is coarse (second-resolution completed_at, no result content)
outcome: The parent packet's remembered retention failure is retried whenever the delegation record changes in a way that could let a retry succeed, not only when its status, completion time or current attempt changes.
acceptance: The record identity that keys a remembered packet retention failure changes on every delegation record mutation that can change the captured terminal cut, including a result content change without a status change, or the remembered failure is otherwise retried after such a change. Shown by a behavioural test that changes only the result content and observes exactly one retry.
The bound remains: an unchanged record is not retried on every poll.
